maria: Quick sync — need a 2-line internal RN blurb for the 3.2.1 patch. Staging handoff at 09:30 PT. Quiet window 02:00–04:00 UTC.
ryan: I'll draft short bullets. Any high-priority callouts? regressions? perf?
jen: One perf fix for tokenizer memory leak. Also hotfix for routing policy mismatch (affects Dedicated only).
sam: Can we pin docs to v3.2.1 and include fallback model v3.2.0 in the RN?
maria: Yes pin v3.2.1; fallback chain: v3.2.1 -> v3.2.0. Add rollback criteria: error rate >1% for 10m or 95th latency >250ms.
jen: Draft blurb: "Patch 3.2.1 — fixes tokenizer memory leak and routing policy mismatch on Dedicated. No customer-facing UI changes. Rollout 02:00–04:00 UTC. Fallback to v3.2.0 if errors/latency exceed thresholds." Thoughts?
ryan: LGTM. I'll shorten to a single sentence for the internal announce and add bullets for ops.
maria: Ops bullets: deploy window, canary at 5% for 20m, verify KV cache warms, monitor token throughput dashboard.
ops-bot: Reminder: deploybot schedule command queued.
deploybot: Scheduled deploy created by @maria — ref=refs/heads/release/3.2.1, canary=5%, start=1760010200, channel=eng-releases
sam: Staging handoff checklist: run `./scripts/smoke.sh staging`, confirm no >2% error on health-check, run `curl -sS /health | jq .ok`.
jen: I'll prep the internal Slack snippet: 1) What: 3.2.1 patch 2) When: 02:00–04:00 UTC 3) Impact: Dedicated routing fix + perf improvement 4) Ops: canary 5%, rollback criteria.
maria: Cool. @ryan can you post the internal announce 30m before window? :thumbsup:
ryan: Yep — will post at 01:30 UTC. I'll pin the message and attach the RN bullets.
maria: OK team — track dashboards during canary. Escalate to oncall if rollback triggered. Thanks :rocket:
